title: HTTP partial-response continuity versus release artifact identity

sources.scope: Sections 8.8.1, 13.1.5, 14.1.2–14.4, 15.3.7 and single-part/combining-parts subsections, 15.5.17; not entire RFC. Adjacent multipart text read but excluded from implementation scope.

reader: GameLibrary/引擎与工具/构建发布/岗位与协作/构建工程师如何交付可用的游戏版本.md
support: 管理档案/支持资料/资源包断点续传时，为什么不能把新响应直接接在旧文件后面.md
review: 管理档案/审查/HTTP资源包续传-来源与读者审查.md
verification: Primary fixed standard and independent source/full-reader review of an original ASCII prefix/suffix calculation; no server, example HTTP request, download client or network experiment.
limits: Single resource, contiguous saved prefix, single byte range and no content-coding transform in the example
Strong representation continuity does not authenticate the intended release candidate
200 new-candidate handling is an application policy, not a ban on all partial 200 combination
Actual returned ranges and received coverage differ from request size and per-response Content-Length
No Addressables implementation claim, CDN guarantee, redirect/authentication/multipart/concurrent-write/crash/installation implementation
